Imagine starting your day in a buzzing warehouse where no two days are ever the same. As a Warehouse Operative, you’ll become part of an enthusiastic and supportive team that keeps everything running smoothly behind the scenes. From the moment products arrive until they’re on their way to customers, you’ll play a key role in making it all happen.

You’ll move between different departments. Sometimes you’re receiving goods in inbound, other times you’re carefully picking and packing orders that need to go out the door. Every task you handle contributes to a seamless process, ensuring customers get exactly what they need, right on time.

Along the way, you’ll also get hands-on experience with equipment like forklifts, reach trucks, and OPT systems. Never used them before? That’s no problem, comprehensive training is provided so you can quickly gain confidence and expand your skills.

Teamwork is at the heart of this role. You’ll collaborate closely with your colleagues, supporting each other to hit daily targets and celebrating successes together. Accuracy and attention to detail are key, because every order counts and every customer matters.

This is more than just a warehouse role. It’s a chance to grow, learn, and become part of a dynamic environment where your contribution truly makes a difference.

Proficiency in English or Dutch is required.

- Good salary depending on your experience
- Direct contract with the employer
- Supportive working environment: training provided so you can develop your skills
- Dynamic and varied role: no two days are the same
- Career opportunities: chance to grow further in warehousing and logistics

jobs.occupation: Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Roosendaal
jobs.description:
Join Albert Heijn Online in Roosendaal as a delivery driver. Earn €18.83 gross per hour all-in through Consolid and work a flexible 12-32 hours per week. Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83, including holiday allowance and applicable allowances. 25 vacation days based on full-time employment. Pension accrual. Travel allowance. A flexible contract for 12 to 32 hours per week. The opportunity to submit your own availability. Shifts from Monday through Sunday. Morning, afternoon and evening shifts. Training and support from an experienced buddy. Employee discount through the Albert Heijn Bonus Card. Opportunities to develop within the role and become a buddy yourself. A varied position combining driving, physical activity and customer contact. Opportunities for long-term employment through Consolid. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Roosendaal Your working day starts at Paardenblok 1 in Roosendaal. Here, you collect the keys to your delivery van, check the route prepared for you and get ready to leave. Once on the road, you follow the navigation to customers throughout Roosendaal and the surrounding area. Every stop brings a new order and a new customer. When you arrive, you select the correct grocery crates from the van and check the order using a handheld scanner. You then carry the groceries to the customer's door and make sure everything is delivered correctly. A friendly approach is an important part of the job. You answer questions when needed, process payments when applicable and take empty crates and returnable packaging back with you. Once the delivery is complete, you continue to your next stop. This role offers more than just driving. You regularly get in and out of the van, carry grocery crates and walk between the vehicle and customers' doors. This keeps you active throughout your shift. After completing all deliveries, you return to the Roosendaal location. You finish your route, return the necessary equipment a

leave the van ready for the next driver. Do I need previous experience as a delivery driver? No previous delivery experience is required. During your first working days, an experienced buddy will help you learn the job. You will receive practical training on the delivery van, scanner and systems, as well as guidance on customer service and the situations you may encounter during a route. How many hours can I work? You can work between 12 and 32 hours per week and submit your availability. Albert Heijn Online delivers from Monday through Sunday. For this position, you need to be available for at least two shifts per week and two Saturdays per month. Is this a physically active job? Yes. Driving is an important part of your shift, but you will also regularly walk, lift grocery crates and get in and out of the delivery van. You should therefore be comfortable with physical activity during your working day. Are there opportunities to grow? Yes. Once you have gained experience, you may have the opportunity to become a buddy and help train new delivery drivers. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Roosendaal You are at least 18 years old. You have a valid category B driving licence. You speak Dutch and/or English. You are available for at least two shifts per week. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. You have a friendly and customer-focused attitude. You are comfortable working independently. You drive safely and responsibly. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. You are able to travel independently to Paardenblok 1 in Roosendaal. Ready to start delivering groceries in Roosendaal? Apply through Consolid for the position of delivery driver at Albert Heijn Online. For questions about the position, contact Seyyed by phone or WhatsApp at 06 83110102, or email s.parwiz@consolid.nl.
